scope.description: An optional compositional direction for a user-requested airborne or floating subject. Make the subject a small, clearly readable event held in a very large uninterrupted color field, with at most one restrained ground or horizon cue. This tests scale, suspension, and pictorial emptiness; it does not prescribe a person, a jump, a street, a camera trick, or any source-work layout.
limitations: Activate only when the user's subject is explicitly airborne or floating.
Preserve the requested subject, count, action, identity, clothing, and silhouette.
Keep the subject small relative to the field but large enough to read; do not crop or erase it.
Use one low, quiet spatial cue only when needed to clarify scale; do not invent a street, rooftop, building, or audience.
Render as a materially painted image, not as a documentary photograph or photomontage.
Do not reproduce the composition, pose, setting, or visual arrangement of a named work.
